cs555 group project.name: CS555 Group Project
cs555 group project.note:
Sprint 1 kickoff notes
- Standup Tuesdays and Thursdays, 4pm
- Backend: Express + JSON file for now
- Demo date: Dec 5. Slides due Dec 3.
- Everyone claims at least 2 tasks before Friday.

tasks.note: Project name only, case-insensitive. No passwords yet.
tasks.userStories: As a team member, I can log in with just a project name so I can reach the board quickly.
As a team member, I can see everyone's tasks and filter by assigned/unassigned so I know what's open.

tasks.note: Start with textarea, then add file upload via multer.
tasks.userStories: As a team member, I can upload and read group notes so the whole team shares the same context.

tasks.note: Fibonacci cards: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13. Reveal and reset buttons.
tasks.userStories: As a participant, I can pick an effort card privately and reveal all cards together so estimates aren't biased.
As a new teammate, I can follow the README to run the app locally in under five minutes.

tasks.note: Two people editing at once: last write wins right now.
tasks.userStories: As a user, my task edits are not silently overwritten when someone else edits at the same time.

apollo.name: Apollo
apollo.note:
Mobile app redesign.
Design review is Friday. Keep the onboarding flow under 4 screens.

tasks.note: Screenshot every step and count taps.
tasks.userStories: As a designer, I have screenshots of every onboarding step so we can count taps.
As a user with low vision, I can read all text because the palette passes WCAG AA contrast.
As a user, I can find and change my notification settings in two taps.
As a researcher, I have a short script so every interview covers the same questions.

tasks.note: Use the sign-up sheet from last quarter.
tasks.userStories: As a researcher, I have five interviews booked so we get feedback before the design review.

lunch club.name: Lunch Club
lunch club.note:
Silly low-stakes project for testing.
Vote on Friday lunch spots, rotate who picks.

tasks.userStories: As a club member, I can suggest a restaurant and note my dietary needs.
As the organizer, I have a reservation for 6 so we are not turned away.

tasks.note: Venmo handles in the pinned message.
tasks.userStories: As a club member, I can see what I owe after lunch without doing math.
